verification.validation: Focused media grant, admission, Range/HEAD/ETag, revocation and log-redaction regressions with Go race tests, vet and build, plus frontend tests/typecheck/build validate this patch. Executor sources and canonical tasks are unchanged; the immutable executor/v0.49.5 inventory is reused. No publication or NAS acceptance is implied.

changes: Add session-bound media grants (Go media package, dsm.NewMediaAuthenticator, frontend mediaUrl) so native audio and video elements can play and seek private App media with GET, HEAD and Range, without a SynoToken in the URL or a public route.
Grants bind the DSM session, subject, App entry, install generation and asset owner revision, default to 5 minutes, renew while in use and can be revoked.
Redact media_grant values and Set-Cookie headers in logs only; client responses are unchanged.
Reuse the immutable executor/v0.49.5 release and its six digests.
